name: Marriage And Virginity
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is God's ordained union between a man and a woman, designed for companionship and unity, as seen when God created a suitable helper for Adam (Genesis 2:18) and established that a man shall leave his parents and become one flesh with his wife (Genesis 2:24). The purity of virginity is emphasized as a condition for marriage, particularly for a priest’s wife (Leviticus 21:13), and the responsibility of a man to honor and provide for a virgin he has enticed is mandated (Exodus 22:16). Christ affirms the permanence of this union, instructing that what God has joined together must not be separated (Matthew 19:6), underscoring the sacredness of marriage and the value placed on virginity within this covenant.
